## Marcie Braswell Named Executive Director of the Regions Foundation


Nov 17, 2026


*Longtime philanthropic advisor and nonprofit specialist to lead the Regions Foundation’s next chapter of community impact.*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The[Regions Foundation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Ffoundation&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Foundation&index=1&md5=e10d3101d7a6dde37b49b2aa075e684a) on Tuesday announced **Marcie Braswell** has been appointed to serve as executive director, bringing extensive experience in philanthropy, nonprofit support, charitable giving strategies, and community investment to the role. The appointment of Braswell is effective Jan. 4, 2027.


Marcie Braswell brings years of experience helping nonprofits protect, preserve and grow their finances. In her new role with the Regions Foundation, she will directly support organizations improving the quality of life throughout communities served by Regions Bank.


The Regions Foundation is a nonprofit funded primarily by[Regions Bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Bank&index=2&md5=178c1e4f9db302b0150f98a064ab00bc) . The Foundation supports a wide range of initiatives throughout the Southeast, Midwest and Texas, with a primary focus on programs that support the following priorities:


**1.) Economic and Community Development:**


- Affordable housing
- Small-business development
- Neighborhood revitalization
- Job creation


**2.) Education and Workforce Readiness:**


- College and career readiness
- Credentials and employment
- Educational access and success
- Educator training


**3.) Creating Greater Financial Wellness:**


- Financial education for youth, adults and vulnerable populations
- Financial planning resources
- Homebuyer readiness


The Regions Foundation also supports organizations on the front lines of[disaster recovery](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-foundation-awards-100000-in-hurricane-isaias-disaster-recovery-grants%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=disaster+recovery&index=3&md5=1acf17c1630165242a6414691a120a01) , with a long history of providing[grants to nonprofits](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-bank-and-the-regions-foundation-announce-flood-recovery-response-for-indiana-communities%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=grants+to+nonprofits&index=4&md5=56d48ff6daca7a6fdf43786377ce3410) providing urgent, on-site relief.


**Marcie Braswell’s Experience Complements the Regions Foundation’s Focus:**


Braswell will join the Regions Foundation from Regions Bank’s[Wealth Management](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fwealth-management&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=Wealth+Management&index=5&md5=d57b858acf6c216ebeb6e2b1e30a558c) division, where she serves as head of the[Philanthropic Solutions](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fwealth-management%2Fphilanthropic-solutions%2Fnonprofit-organizations&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=Philanthropic+Solutions&index=6&md5=5666e9a1a2bdeff7d32aad2884a6336e) group. In that role, she leads a team of advisors helping private foundations, family foundations, public charities, nonprofits and other mission-driven clients align financial resources with charitable goals and long-term community impact.


Prior to leading Philanthropic Solutions, Braswell headed the Endowments and Foundations team within[Regions Institutional Services](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fwealth-management%2Finstitutional-services&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Institutional+Services&index=7&md5=e4505080f96e176a8bb217c427beb680) for nearly a decade, working closely with nonprofits and philanthropic leaders to strengthen stewardship, governance, investment management and organizational sustainability.


**Building on the Regions Foundation’s Legacy of Service:**


“Marcie brings a unique combination of financial expertise and nonprofit support that will serve the Regions Foundation and our community partners exceptionally well,” said **Leroy Abrahams** , head of Community and Market Engagement for Regions Bank and Chairman and President of the Regions Foundation. “The Regions Foundation has built a reputation for delivering[financial support](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Finvesting-in-opportunity-regions-foundation-supports-workforce-growth%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=financial+support&index=8&md5=b43cd0d20a7d1e8e9bc9edbb6d82e507) and community partnerships designed to help people, families, and[small-business owners](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-foundation-expands-support-for-sloss-tech-ideas-boosting-grand-prize-to-100000%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=small-business+owners&index=9&md5=d62dc7b3028ea744eb6bb7db6fcd2db3) thrive. Marcie’s leadership and insights will further elevate the Foundation’s role in enhancing the quality of life throughout the communities served by Regions Bank.”


**Real Results – The Regions Foundation’s Lasting Impact:**


Since its launch in 2018, the Regions Foundation has invested more than $39 million in communities across the Southeast, Midwest and Texas. Among recent examples:


- In Birmingham, headquarters city of Regions Bank, the Regions Foundation[supports small-business investments](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-foundation-expands-support-for-sloss-tech-ideas-boosting-grand-prize-to-100000%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=supports+small-business+investments&index=10&md5=562bad4564b095973ef8e2df83ac0c53) through a collaboration with TechBirmingham and the Sloss.Tech/Ideas competition.
- In Metro Atlanta, Regions Foundation funding is[helping the Jumpstart Automotive Training Center train young adults](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fhigh-gear-jumpstart-automotive-expands-impact-with-regions-foundation-support%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=helping+the+Jumpstart+Automotive+Training+Center+train+young+adults&index=11&md5=a8c4f86239b0507a5980b994a212ea51) for well-paying, in-demand careers as automotive repair specialists.
- In Dallas and Fort Worth, the Regions Foundation[supported entrepreneurship training](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fthe-pitch-wind-up%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=supported+entrepreneurship+training&index=12&md5=4078d41b619c9380fc09af74dd9a8d3c) through[the DEC Network](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthedec.co%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=the+DEC+Network&index=13&md5=6452412e0ce7ab70b7038f601dd20c20) .
- In North Alabama, the Regions Foundation[delivered a substantial grant](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fempowering-entrepreneurs-regions-foundation-supports-huntsvilles-growth%2F&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=delivered+a+substantial+grant&index=14&md5=b5418df28ba921218770b9295e5256dc) to the NCI Loan Fund, a Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) operated by Huntsville-based nonprofit Neighborhood Concepts, Inc. This funding helps entrepreneurs secure resources they need to succeed.


As executive director of the Regions Foundation, Braswell will oversee operations and strategic direction, including grantmaking, community partnerships and initiatives designed to create greater economic opportunity and improve quality of life.


“The Regions Foundation has built an impressive record of helping organizations create positive, lasting change,” **Braswell said** . “For many years, I’ve had the privilege of working alongside nonprofit leaders, donors and community organizations that are committed to making a difference. I’m honored to join the Regions Foundation and continue that work by supporting programs that expand opportunity, strengthen communities and help people build brighter financial futures.”


Before joining Regions Bank in 2014, Braswell practiced law for 16 years as an associate and later shareholder with Maynard Cooper & Gale, now Maynard Nexsen. She holds a Bachelor of Science in Marketing from Louisiana State University and a Juris Doctor from Washington and Lee University School of Law.


**About the Regions Foundation**


The Alabama-based Regions Foundation supports community investments that positively impact communities served by Regions Bank. The Foundation engages in a grantmaking program focused on priorities including economic and community development; education and workforce readiness; and financial wellness. The Foundation is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) corporation funded primarily through contributions from Regions Bank. To learn more about the Regions Foundation, visit[www.regions.com/foundation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Ffoundation&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com%2Ffoundation&index=15&md5=c4d83147c72d8d1a00181175b240e12d) .


**About Regions Financial Corporation**


Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $163 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54642379&newsitemid=20261116519002&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=16&md5=5c31906d8e864bac98cb26b93c011c2d) .
